services.name: Sunset Dinner Cruise
services.desc: The Gondola Getaway is now offering something like never before, a Sunset Dinner Cruise! We have been doing pizza cruises now for many years for private groups but we are now offering a “community” family style that allows you to reserve a seat even as just one! Your reservation will land you a seat on the most unique dining experience in Southern California. Our large Gondola is fit with a custom table that seats 10. Your dining experience will float you through the enchanting canals of Naples with two trained Gondoliers as you dine on antipasto, pasta, pizza, salad and garlic bread. Make Public Cruise • Offered 10/20/23

quotes.author: Jacqueline T
quotes.text: 5 STARS! Took a Gondola ride for our 42nd wedding anniversary. It was a wonderful experience. Our Gondolier, Waylon was so kind and knowledgeable. He took us around the canal's and explained a bit of history here and there and pointed out interesting things like the house with the fake shark head sticking out. He played a little romantic music and make the date really special for me and my husband. Thank you, Gondola Getaway and Waylon. And it was free parking! Ice cream shop a short drive away. Yum!

quotes.author: TasteofTuscany
quotes.text: Fantastic Gondola Experience, great Host (Josh)?, great staff, easy access and also free parking. Overall great experience. The trip was perfect, the add-on's well worth it such as message in a bottle and snack trays. The route is great and just the right amount of time. Looking forward to the night cruise. We took a noon cruise. Very clean and professional, comfortable and friendly. Perfect.

quotes.author: Chris H
quotes.text: This was such a good time. A perfect night for a gondola ride under the full moon. It was a bit chilly but they had blankets available for us to use. Our gondolier was so fun. He kept us entertained as well as gave us some fun facts about the island. The experience is great for date night, proposals, friend dates and family adventure. Its a must do when in the Long Beach area.

quotes.author: Laurie O
quotes.text: We had a great evening celebrating my mom’s special birthday. There was room enough for six adults. Jared was knowledgeable about the different houses and the history of Naples. Lots of great conversation and he also seeing us a beautiful song under one of the bridges. It was a cool way to spend a hot night in Long Beach!

quotes.author: Deannena H
quotes.text: We had a great time on our gondola dinner cruise, led by Jake and Josh. We were able to see amazing sights and architecture, and loved how informative and fun our guides were! The food was great too- the chicken Alfredo pizza was a hit!
5 Stars! Perfect for any age, especially us older folks!
